title: Case 29 of the Gateless Gate
speaker: Heather Shoren Larusso
summary: The talk's main teaching is about cultivating a detached awareness by stopping attachment to thoughts and perceptions. This means letting go of our fixed views and investigating what's truly perceiving them, rather than getting caught up in dualistic analysis or identifying with thinking. By doing so, we can tap into the wisdom that animates all things, including ourselves and others, and find a common ground beyond our individual perspectives.
